title: Negative result: every scalar decoder on the PR2297 five-frame cover costs at least 554 (sharp; u=5 scalar row has no saving; no κ)
body:
## Statement

**Negative result (exact sharp bound with proof; scoped proof plus exact finite certificate). No κ claim, no supplier, no change to the selected result.**

On the exact PR2297 five-frame cover (22 orthonormal five-frames and one orthonormal pair, 112 ports, `sum d_i = 554`, no free (orthogonal) group pair, so `K = c I_112`), every finite scalar factorization `c I_112 = A diag(c_t) B^T` over `Q`, or over any field, has full-port cost

    C = sum_t rank_F2(pairing on L_t x R_t) >= 554.

The direct one-term-per-port decoder attains 554, so the bound is sharp. The zero-saving threshold is `floor(4432/9) = 492`, so every scalar decoder has deficit (budget minus cost) at most `-554/9`. This holds for every number of terms, every support pattern (matched or unmatched spans), every sign and every denominator.

**Proof (PROOF.md).**
1. *Lemma 1 (principal-rank count).* For every group set `S`, `K[S,S] = c I_{f(S)}`, so at least `f(S) = sum_{g in S} d_g` terms are nonzero on `S` on both sides. This is a rank statement over the base field; no mod-2 reduction, so even denominators play no role.
2. *Lemma 2 (LP duality over flats).* If nonnegative weights `y_S` satisfy, for every ordered pair of flats `(F, F')`, `sum_{S meets both} y_S <= rho(F, F')`, then `C >= sum_S y_S f(S)`. Arbitrary supports reduce to their closures (same spans and costs; hitting is monotone). The cover has 107 flats.
3. *Certificate.* `CERTIFICATE.json`: 88 group sets, integer weights over `10^6`, all 11,449 ordered flat-pair constraints satisfied exactly (minimum slack `6/10^6`), value `553996479/1000000 > 553`. `C` is an integer, so `C >= 554`. (The certified LP value lies in `[553.996479, 554]`; that the LP optimum is exactly 554 is not certified.)

## Declared milestone and decision informed

Milestone: local module (scoped proof), card `coverage-law-change`. Decision: whether the u=5 (k=5) coverage lever row can give any positive saving under the scalar-decoder contract on this cover. **It cannot.** This closes the general unmatched-span, even-denominator class left open by PR #2879 (Arham Tahir; equal spans only, plus a necessary condition of >= 16 unmatched terms with total asymmetry credit `sum delta_t >= 62`) and by PR #2532 / philippeVV's Theorem 1 (2-integral decoders only), and answers PR #2532's open question "even-denominator gain for k=5": the achievable saving is zero.

Scope of the consequence: **scalar decoders only.** A k-port saving on this row now needs a mask with free pairs, another tariff, another cover, or another endpoint contract (an operator/block-valued decoder such as PR2297's `C_E^2` blocks or PR #3480 by Gonzalo Mier). Non-scalar endpoint contracts are not addressed.

## Base and pins

- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` (priority revision 6; canonical main unchanged at submission).
- Inputs: `research/community-frontier1094-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz` sha256 `f1da8061…d529d6` (member `DATA-PHASES.json` sha256 `c5916ff3…8251fa`); `research/kport-group-scalar-endpoint-audit/fixtures/PR2297-CANDIDATE.json` sha256 `5b69c7a8…a86c0`. Full pins in `SOURCES.json` / `VERIFY.json`.
- Certificate: `CERTIFICATE.json` sha256 `7c800588…adcc525`.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/pr2297-principal-rank-floor/verify.py
```

Stdlib only, about 2 s and 35 MB. Final line `PASS_PR2297_PRINCIPAL_RANK_FLOOR`; JSON includes `flats 107`, `flat_pairs 11449`, `certificate_sets 88`, `certificate_value 553996479/1000000`, `min_slack_numerator 6`, `floor 554`, `direct_decoder_cost 554`, `zero_saving_threshold 492`, `unpaid_budget 4432/9`, `exact_instance_cost 691`. Generic hook: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr2297-principal-rank-floor` (PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE).

Second methods inside the verifier: flats enumerated twice (BFS closure; spans of all <= 5-group subsets with closedness check); pairing ranks twice (packed Gram elimination; `dim F - dim(F ∩ F'^perp)`); 2,000 seeded random non-closed supports checked with directly computed ranks; an exact rational decoder with denominators 2/4/8 (`K = c0 I_112` checked entrywise, cost 691) satisfies the full inequality chain.

**Negative controls (all rejected):** one certificate weight inflated by 1; `rho(ambient, ambient)` set to 8; line-label tariff in place of the full-port tariff; doubled certificate; flat method B fed a group list missing one group (must disagree with method A); a mutated cover with a free (orthogonal) group pair (`cover()` must reject it, for that reason).

## Scope, assumptions, unresolved obligations

- Exact PR2297 cover, scalar-decoder contract, full-port tariff (as in PR #2532 / PR #2879). Not a complete multiplication theorem.
- Inherited, not re-derived: the full-port tariff, `K = c I_112` from the PR #2532 mask rule, and the 8/9 portwise planning law of PR #2879 §3 (budget `4432/9`). The conclusion does not hinge on 8/9 alone: 554 also exceeds PR #2532's incumbent-tie band 455-460 and PR #3344's (Matarener) u=5 rank-32 copy budget 488.
- Lemmas 1 and 2 are written out but not proof-assistant checked.
- Native frames, restoration, hosting, precision and the complete consumer are unpriced (moot for this row only because no decoder saves). Other covers, other `u`, masks with free pairs and non-scalar contracts are not covered.

## Search record

Certificate search (`find_certificate.py`, provenance helper only, not a verifier requirement; numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 HiGHS): 3,252 candidate sets (all 23 singletons, all 253 pairs, the full set, 3,000 seeded random sets of size 3-20, seed 20261019) against all flat-pair rows; LP value 553.9999999999999; weights floored to `10^-6` and shrunk 2 ppm, then checked exactly. Rerun reproduced the shipped certificate byte for byte. A differently formulated LP (dominance-pruned rows) gave a different 93-set vertex with the same value. No decoder search was needed.

Overlap check (2026-10-19, ~00:55Z and refreshed ~01:20Z): gh PR searches (PR2297, k-port decoder, five-frame, unmatched span, even-denominator, principal rank, scalar decoder floor), open PRs since 2026-10-17, open PRs by thakrarsagar, and Discussions #1587, #2292, #2049 and #1166 (read-only). No competing result found. `scripts/find_overlap.py` was not refreshed. Concurrent related work on different objects: the lost-free plane-mask line (#3625 Matarener, #3674 ToikY, #3676 and #3756 jwr404) and the rank-57 triad line (#2757 and #3684 flyingviper; #3505, #3513, #3527, #3538 petalas).

## Claim and review provenance

Reviewed in two rounds of independent AI review passes in the same loop (reproducibility, mathematics, provenance, referee); two of those passes recomputed the certificate with separate scripts. All blocking/major findings were fixed; the final round's verdicts were "ship". There has been no human review.
